text.11:59: And such were A'ad. They denied the revelations of their Lord and flouted His messengers and followed the command of every froward potentate.
text.14:15: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;
text.50:24: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
text.74:16: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
